tasks.label: Verify Dental Clinic Phase 3 ZIP
tasks.command: Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; $zip = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead('C:\Users\Andre Tapaganao\Desktop\ADNRE\dental-clinic-phase3.zip'); try { $entries = @($zip.Entries | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Replace('\', '/') }); $required = @('dental-clinic/README.md','dental-clinic/index.php','dental-clinic/verify-email.php','dental-clinic/patient/book.php','dental-clinic/admin/reports.php','dental-clinic/database/phase3_migration.sql','dental-clinic/config/.htaccess','dental-clinic/database/.htaccess','dental-clinic/includes/.htaccess'); $missing = @($required | Where-Object { $entries -notcontains $_ }); if ($missing.Count) { throw ('ZIP missing: ' + ($missing -join ', ')) }; 'ZIP verified: ' + $entries.Count + ' entries, all required files including hidden access rules are present.' } finally { $zip.Dispose() }
